from.place: Definition of the restricted compactification lower shriek and its inherited shift comparison

title: Restriction of compactification lower shriek to the localizing closure
statement:
For a condensed coefficient ring $\Lambda$ on the pro-étale site and schemes $X,Y$ with a
morphism $f:X\to Y$, let $c$ be a compactification of $f$. Write
$\Loc_X=\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda))$ and $\Loc_Y=\Loc(\Dctf(Y,\Lambda))$ as in
[sk-def-localizing-closure], and let
$R\!f^c_!$ be the ambient compactification lower-shriek functor of
[sk-def-sfb-module-derived-lower-shriek]. Given a preservation map
$$
h:\ \forall K,\ \Loc_X(K)\to\Loc_Y(R\!f^c_!(K)),$$
the *localizing lower-shriek attached to $c$* is the full-subcategory functor
$$
\mathsf{L}\!f^c_!:\ \Loc_X\hookrightarrow D_X
  \xrightarrow{R\!f^c_!}D_Y\quad\text{lifted to}\quad\Loc_Y,
$$
with object membership supplied by $h$. When both localizing closures carry their
inherited triangulated structures, this restricted functor is equipped with the
commutative shift structure induced by the ambient functor.

noncomputable def localizingLowerShriek (c : Compactification f)
    (h : ∀ K, localizingClosureProEtale Λ X K → localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y
      ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ c).obj K)) :
    (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (localizingClosureProEtale Λ Y).FullSubcategory
